name: academic-paper-reviewer
description: Multi-perspective academic paper review with dynamic reviewer personas. Runs a 5-seat, role-separated review panel (Journal-Fit Reviewer + 3 peer-review roles + Devil's Advocate) with field-specific expertise; role separation is not a claim of independent error processes. Supports full review, re-review (verification), quick assessment, methodology focus, Socratic guided, and calibration modes. Triggers on: review paper, peer review, manuscript review, referee report, review my paper, critique p
author: Imbad0202
summary_zh: 一款模拟多角色审稿委员会的论文评审工具，适合多视角检查论文质量、方法缺陷及期刊匹配度。
